# External filling starts with the normal submit draft, even without a template.

as 'Test <test@example.com>'
at '2026-11-25T18:49:09Z'

cd repo
git init
git commit --allow-empty -m Initial
shamhub-setup
shamhub new origin alice/example.git
shamhub register alice
git push origin main
env SHAMHUB_USERNAME=alice
gs auth login
git config spice.message.fill.command mock-message
env MOCK_MESSAGE_RESPONSE=$WORK/message.txt
env MOCK_MESSAGE_RECORD=$WORK/invocation

# Multiple commits supply the oldest subject and combined messages in order.
git add feature.txt
gs branch create feature -m First -m 'First body'
gs commit create --allow-empty -m Second -m 'Second body'
gs --no-prompt branch submit --fill --no-draft
stderr 'Created #1'
cmp $WORK/invocation/draft $WORK/golden/combined-draft.txt

# Without commits, the draft title is the branch name.
gs branch create empty --no-commit
gs --no-prompt branch submit --fill --no-draft
stderr 'Created #2'
cmp $WORK/invocation/draft $WORK/golden/empty-branch-draft.txt

# Leaving the draft unchanged produces the normal CR title and body.
shamhub dump changes
cmpenvJSON stdout $WORK/golden/changes.json

-- repo/feature.txt --
feature
-- message.txt --
{{.Draft}}
-- golden/combined-draft.txt --
First

First

First body

Second

Second body
-- golden/empty-branch-draft.txt --
empty

-- golden/changes.json --
